proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D hAC hs h1 h2
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hw⟩ := AffineSubspace.wOppSide_iff_exists_wbtw.mp hs.1
  have hB := hs.2.1
  have hD := hs.2.2
  obtain ⟨x, ⟨hx0, hx1⟩, rfl⟩ := hw
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hp
  have hx0' : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; apply hB; simpa using hp
  have hx1' : x ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl; apply hD; simpa using hp
  have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_le_of_ne hx0 (Ne.symm hx0')
  have hxlt : x < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hx1 hx1'
  set u : V := B -ᵥ A with hu
  set w : V := C -ᵥ A with hw
  set v : V := D -ᵥ A with hv
  have hDB : D -ᵥ B = v - u := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right D B A).symm
  have h3 : u + x • (v - u) = y • w := by
    have h4 := congrArg (· -ᵥ A) hy
    simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub, vadd_vsub_assoc, hDB] at h4
    rw [add_comm]
    exact h4.symm
  set α : ℝ := -(1 - x) / x with hα
  set β : ℝ := y / x with hβ
  have hv' : v = α • u + β • w := by
    have : x • v = (-(1 - x)) • u + y • w := by rw [← h3]; module
    rw [hα, hβ, div_eq_inv_mul, div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, mul_smul, ← smul_add, ← this, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hx0', one_smul]
  have hαneg : α < 0 := by
    rw [hα]; exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hxpos
  have nsq : ∀ a b : ℝ, ‖a • u + b • w‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * a * b * inner ℝ u w + b ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro a b
    rw [norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs,
      real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
    ring
  have hwpos : 0 < ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    have : w ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hAC.symm
    positivity
  have E1 : α ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * α * β * inner ℝ u w + β ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ u w + ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    have e1 : ‖v‖ = ‖(1 : ℝ) • u + (-1 : ℝ) • w‖ := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) • u + (-1 : ℝ) • w = B -ᵥ C := by
        rw [one_smul, neg_one_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg, hu, hw, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right]
      rw [this, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub V B C, h2, dist_eq_norm_vsub V D A]
    have e2 := nsq 1 (-1)
    rw [← e1, hv', nsq] at e2
    linarith
  have E2 : α ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * α * (β - 1) * inner ℝ u w + (β - 1) ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
    have e1 : ‖α • u + (β - 1) • w‖ = ‖u‖ := by
      have : α • u + (β - 1) • w = D -ᵥ C := by
        rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right D C A, ← hv, ← hw, hv']; module
      rw [this, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub V D C, dist_comm, ← h1, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A]
    have e2 := nsq α (β - 1)
    rw [e1] at e2
    exact e2.symm
  have L : (α + 1) * inner ℝ u w + (β - 1) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by linear_combination (1 / 2) * E1 - (1 / 2) * E2
  have hcs : 0 < ‖u‖ ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ u w ^ 2 := by
    have hne : ‖w‖ ^ 2 • u - inner ℝ u w • w ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hB
      have : u = (inner ℝ u w / ‖w‖ ^ 2) • w := by
        rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← sub_eq_zero.mp h0, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwpos.ne', one_smul]
      have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (inner ℝ u w / ‖w‖ ^ 2) A C
      rwa [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hw, ← this, hu, vsub_vadd] at h3
    have h5 : 0 < ‖‖w‖ ^ 2 • u + (- inner ℝ u w) • w‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [neg_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
      have := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
      positivity
    rw [nsq] at h5
    have h6 : 0 < ‖w‖ ^ 2 * (‖u‖ ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ u w ^ 2) := by linarith [h5, (by ring : ‖w‖ ^ 2 * (‖u‖ ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ u w ^ 2) = (‖w‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 * -inner ℝ u w * inner ℝ u w + (-inner ℝ u w) ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2)]
    exact (pos_iff_pos_of_mul_pos h6).mp hwpos
  have K : (α + 1) * (α - 1) * (‖u‖ ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ u w ^ 2) = 0 := by
    linear_combination ‖w‖ ^ 2 * E2 - (2 * α * inner ℝ u w + (β - 1) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 - (α + 1) * inner ℝ u w) * L
  have hα1 : α = -1 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp K with h | h
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
      · linarith
      · linarith
    · exact absurd h hcs.ne'
  have hβ1 : β = 1 := by
    rw [hα1] at L
    have : (β - 1) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · linarith
    · exact absurd h hwpos.ne'
  rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C D A, ← hw, ← hv, hv', hα1, hβ1, hu]
  module
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), A ≠ C → (line[ℝ, A, C]).SOppSide B D → dist A B = dist C D → dist B C = dist D A → B -ᵥ A = C -ᵥ D
